environment.description: Same Flask application deployed identically on EC2 behind ALB, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL has three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode except 'SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING' which is in BLOCK mode with a 1024-byte query string limit; (2) Priority 200 - A custom rule group 'app-input-sanitization' containing a single RegexPatternSet rule that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'value' with pattern '(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|\x27\s*(?:or|and)\s+\x27|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()' in BLOCK mode with 403 response; (3) Priority 300 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with SqliBody, SqliQueryArguments, and SqliUriPath all in BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the EC2 instance runs with a read-only filesystem mount for /var/app/data/ enforced via a systemd unit override with ReadOnlyPaths=/var/app/data, meaning the audit_log INSERT and any write operations will fail silently (caught by the try/except), but the SELECT-based injection in the search endpoint would still execute if it reached the application.

config.waf_rule_priority_100: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (COUNT mode, except SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING in BLOCK, limit 1024 bytes)
config.waf_rule_priority_200: Custom RegexPatternSet on SingleQueryArgument 'value': blocks UNION SELECT, stacked queries, boolean-based OR/AND with quotes, sleep(), benchmark()
config.waf_rule_priority_300: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with SqliBody, SqliQueryArguments, SqliUriPath all BLOCK
config.network: VPC with public subnet, ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
